You've=20found=20another=20bug=20in=20the=20design=20engine.=20=20Two=20in=
=20one=20week=20--=20no=20prize=20I'm=20
afraid!=20=20

The=20problem=20occurs=20in=20systems=20that=20use=20the=20commer=20","=20=
to=20divide=20the=20integer=20and=20
non-integer=20part=20of=20numbers=20(e.g.,=20you=20write=2010,5=20and=20I=20=
write=2010.5).=20=20This=20
causes=20some=20of=20the=20output=20from=20the=20design=20engine=20to=20be=
=20incorrectly=20formatted.=20=20
What=20comes=20out=20on=20your=20system=20as=20
REALIZED=20LINE=20LENGTH:=201170=20984s
comes=20out=20on=20my=20sytem=20as
REALIZED=20LINE=20LENGTH:=201170.984=20Nautical=20Miles

I=20will=20get=20this=20bug=20fixed=20for=20the=20next=20release=20of=20di=
stance.=20=20Meanwhile,=20I=20hope=20
you'll=20be=20able=20to=20interpret=20your=20output.

=20-=20Len
